name: ACLED (Armed Conflict Location & Event Data)
desc: Real-time disaggregated event data on political violence and protest worldwide, 1997-present.

name: GDELT Project
desc: Machine-coded global event and knowledge-graph data from world news, updated every 15 minutes since 1979.

name: UCDP (Uppsala Conflict Data Program)
desc: Leading data on organized violence: GED events plus yearly armed-conflict/one-sided/non-state datasets, 1946+.

name: Global Terrorism Database (GTD)
desc: Open-source database of 200,000+ domestic and international terrorist attacks worldwide since 1970.

name: Correlates of War (COW)
desc: Foundational quantitative war datasets: inter/intra-state war, MIDs, alliances, national capabilities, 1816+.

name: EM-DAT (Emergency Events Database)
desc: CRED disaster database of 27,000+ mass disasters since 1900 with human and economic impacts.

name: SIPRI Databases
desc: Arms transfers, military expenditure, arms industry, peace operations and embargo databases, 1949+.

name: PRIO (Peace Research Institute Oslo) Data
desc: 39 conflict datasets incl. battle deaths, SVAC, PRIO-GRID, PETRODATA and JPR replication data.

name: Polity5 / Center for Systemic Peace (INSCR)
desc: Polity5 regime data plus major episodes of political violence, coups, state fragility and PITF series.

name: V-Dem (Varieties of Democracy)
desc: Disaggregated democracy indicators across 200+ polities, 1789+, with annual Democracy Reports.

name: Cline Center Machine-Generated Event Data
desc: Historical Phoenix event data (8M+ events, 1945-2019) plus SPEED and Global News Index resources.

name: Ethnic Power Relations (EPR) Dataset Family
desc: ETH Zurich data on ethnic groups' access to state power, settlements and rebellion links, 1946-2021.

name: Mass Mobilization Protest Data Project
desc: Anti-government protest events in all countries, 1990-2020, with actor, demand and response coding.

name: NAVCO (Nonviolent and Violent Campaigns and Outcomes)
desc: Chenoweth dataset on resistance campaigns and tactics, 1900-2021, covering mass mobilizations worldwide.

name: SCAD (Social Conflict Analysis Database)
desc: Social conflict events (protests, riots, strikes, repression) in Africa and Latin America, 1990-2017.

name: POLECAT (PLOVER Event Data)
desc: ICEWS successor: ML-coded geolocated political events from 1000+ news sources, 2018+, updated weekly.

name: ICEWS (Integrated Crisis Early Warning System)
desc: Archived DARPA-funded coded political event data, 1995-2023; superseded by POLECAT.

name: Our World in Data: War and Peace
desc: Open charts and downloadable data on war deaths and trends sourced from UCDP, PRIO, COW and GTD.

name: UCDP/PRIO Armed Conflict Dataset (ACD)
desc: Canonical list of state-based armed conflicts with 25+ battle deaths/year, 1946-present.

name: Correlates of War: Militarized Interstate Disputes (MID)
desc: Disputes where states threaten, display or use force short of war, 1816-2014 (v5.0).

name: Political Instability Task Force (PITF)
desc: US-sponsored data on ethnic/revolutionary war, adverse regime change and genocide/politicide, 1955+.

name: Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) - ACLED & Conflict
desc: OCHA platform redistributing ACLED and other conflict/humanitarian datasets in machine-readable form.

name: UCDP GED (Georeferenced Event Dataset)
desc: Most disaggregated UCDP product: village-level, daily organized-violence events, 1989-present.

name: FAO Hand-in-Hand / UCDP Conflict Catalog
desc: FAO geospatial catalog republishing UCDP georeferenced conflict events for food-security analysis.
